summary: Checked all six new implicit-val docs (doubleOptionShape, jDoubleOptionShape, intOptionShape, jIntegerOptionShape, longOptionShape, jLongOptionShape) against their implementations: each primitive variant's fromJava/fromScala bodies do exactly the presence-check-then-wrap-or-empty conversion described, and each boxed ('j') variant is an asInstanceOf cast reusing the primitive instance, so the 'unboxing the value if present' claim holds because OptionalX.of(...) requires a primitive while the boxed Optional/Option yields a boxed value on .get/pattern-match.
